summary: Iteration 2 testing complete. Backend: 22/22 pytest tests passed (9 new iteration-2 covering POST /api/tests/import-full with idempotency+category validation, GET/PUT /api/settings with public access & auth enforcement, POST /api/settings/logo with PNG upload + content-type validation, GET /api/settings/logo serving bytes + 13 regression tests from iteration 1). Frontend: Settings nav+route works, all 9 settings testids present, lab_name change persists after reload, logo upload succeeds and appears in sidebar + settings preview + report preview (URL /api/settings/logo?v=<path>), Test Catalog shows 'Import Full Catalog' button, after import total jumps to 738 tests, category filter contains all expected categories (Hematology, Biochemistry, Immunology, Virology, Microbiology, Endocrinology, Fluid Analysis, Oncology, Toxicology, Pathology, Urinalysis, Imaging, Parasitology, Cardiac, Serology). Regression flows from iteration 1 unaffected.

issues: Uploaded logo is shown at native pixel size inside the preview tile (small test PNG looked like a broken thumbnail). Consider enforcing min-height / background placeholder when logo is tiny.

critical_code_review_comments: storage.py: put_object/get_object use synchronous `requests` inside async FastAPI endpoints — blocks the event loop under concurrent uploads. Acceptable for admin-only, low-frequency logo updates but should be noted. Consider httpx.AsyncClient if upload volume grows.

/api/settings/logo (GET) is public and re-initialises storage key on 404; a stale/invalid logo_path can return 404 but will refetch storage key on every request — add a short in-memory cache + optional ETag for cache-busting beyond the ?v= query param.
import_full_catalog iterates FULL_CATALOG and awaits insert_one one-by-one (~684 round-trips). Consider insert_many with ordered=False for a ~10x speedup.
full_catalog.categorize() runs string matching per test; fine for a one-shot import but keep in mind for future dynamic re-categorization.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Full catalog import was triggered as part of the test; DB now contains ~738 tests (54 seeded + 684 imported). Second import call correctly returned added=0.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend covered by pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration2.py + backend_test.py. Login testids are staff-login-email / staff-login-password / staff-login-button (NOT login-*). Settings page testids follow settings-<key> pattern. Primary color input is type=text (hex) + a sibling color-picker type=color — fill the hex input to update preview. Catalog category filter is a native <select>, not shadcn Select. REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL must be exported when running pytest from shell (it is not pre-exported by supervisor env).
